currentCompany.description: School insights: a public company facet name or ID (e.g. Google). Alumni profiles: only return people whose public current employer matches.
currentCompany.title: Current company

currentFunction.description: School insights only: a public function facet name or ID (e.g. Engineering).
currentFunction.title: Current function

currentLocation.description: Alumni profiles only: only return people whose public location contains this text.
currentLocation.title: Current location

degree.description: Narrow discovery toward profiles whose public text mentions this degree (mode=alumniProfiles). Degree is best-effort because LinkedIn hides it on most guest profiles.
degree.title: Degree

fieldOfStudy.description: School insights: a public field facet name or ID (e.g. Computer Science). Alumni profiles: searches and prefers this field (best-effort).
fieldOfStudy.title: Field of study

graduationYearRange.description: Alumni profiles only: keep profiles whose public education end year is inside this inclusive range.
graduationYearRange.title: Graduation year range

includeSchoolProfile.description: School insights only: also fetch the school overview page for website, founding year, size, specialties and employee count. Adds one request per school.
includeSchoolProfile.title: Include school profile details

maxAlumniPerSchool.description: Maximum verified public profiles to return per school (mode=alumniProfiles). Values above 200 are clamped to 200 to keep runs bounded.
maxAlumniPerSchool.title: Max alumni per school

maxSchools.description: Maximum number of schools to process in one run.
maxSchools.title: Max schools

mode.description: What to return: public school-level alumni insights, or individual public alumni profiles found by search.
enumTitles: School insights (counts, top employers, fields, functions)
mode.title: Mode

schoolNames.description: Plain university names when you do not have the LinkedIn URL, e.g. MIT or Harvard University. Names are resolved automatically.
schoolNames.title: School names

schoolUrls.description: LinkedIn school page URLs or bare slugs, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/school/mit/ or mit.
schoolUrls.title: School URLs or slugs
